note: Public schemas only; does not establish current connectivity or entitlements.

tools.name: get_financial_history
tools.title: Get financial history
tools.description: Quarterly/annual history of fundamentals (revenue, gross profit, operating income, net income, FCF, EPS, EBITDA, total debt) with yoy_pct and period labels.

date_from.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD (or RFC3339), start of the reporting window; other formats are rejected

date_to.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD (or RFC3339), end of the reporting window; other formats are rejected

tools.name: get_news
tools.title: Get news headlines
tools.description: Latest news headlines for a symbol: id, title, published (unix), provider, urgency (1=top, 2=normal), storyPath, link, permission, relatedSymbols, paywall. Paginated: returns limit (default 25) headlines from offset; response carries total_available and has_more — increase offset to read older headlines (up to 200 total).

lang.description: Language code: en ru de fr es pt it pl tr ar he ko ja vi th ms id zh-Hans zh-Hant ro en_IN. Default en

limit.description: Max headlines per call, default 25, cap 200

offset.description: Skip this many newest headlines; use with limit to page through all available news (see has_more/total_available in the response)

annotations.title: Latest news headlines for a symbol

tools.name: get_financials
tools.title: Get financials snapshot
tools.description: Current fundamental snapshot: P/E, P/B, margins, ROE/ROA, TTM revenue/income/EBITDA/FCF and YoY growth. Optional metric subset and reporting period (fy/fq/ttm/fh/current).

metric.description: Optional subset of financial metrics (aliases like pe, roe, revenue, fcf or raw TV columns); omit for the full set

period.description: Reporting period for metric columns: fy, fq, ttm, fh, current. Default ttm

tools.name: get_earnings_calendar
tools.title: Get earnings calendar
tools.description: Upcoming earnings schedule for a list of symbols: for each symbol only the NEXT scheduled report date plus the single MOST RECENT report date, with consensus EPS/revenue forecasts for the next quarter. Not a history: it holds at most two dates per symbol, and date_from/date_to only filter those two dates (a window covering an older quarter returns an empty list). For past quarters use get_financial_history (reported figures) or get_documents (reports, transcripts).

date_from.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD (or RFC3339), default today. Filters the symbol's two known dates (last report / next scheduled report) — does not fetch older quarters; other formats are rejected

date_to.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD (or RFC3339), default +180d; other formats are rejected

annotations.title: Earnings dates with EPS and revenue consensus

tools.name: get_symbol_data
tools.title: Get symbol data
tools.description: Fetch arbitrary TradingView screener columns for one symbol (escape hatch for advanced queries): stocks, ETFs, crypto, forex, futures, indices, bonds and government bond yields. Use get_screener_columns to discover valid column names.

columns.description: TradingView screener columns to fetch. Default: name description close change change_abs volume market_cap_basic price_earnings_ttm sector industry

annotations.title: Arbitrary TV screener columns for a single symbol

tools.name: get_forecasts
tools.title: Get analyst forecasts
tools.description: Analyst consensus: recommendation + score, buy/hold/sell distribution, price targets with upside_pct, EPS/revenue estimates.

annotations.title: Analyst consensus: ratings, price targets, estimates

tools.name: get_documents
tools.title: List filings & transcripts
tools.description: List filings and transcripts (10-K/10-Q/8-K, earnings calls) for a symbol with view ids for get_document_view. Supports category/event filters and historical event-date windows.

category.description: Category slug: all, annual_reports, quarterly_reports, interim_reports, company_events, insider_transactions, transcripts, presentations, press_releases, other. Also accepts 10-K / 10-Q / 8-K aliases

start_date.description: RFC3339 start of the EVENT-date window (inclusive), historical windows work

end_date.description: RFC3339 end of the EVENT-date window (inclusive)

annotations.title: List of filings and transcripts with view ids

tools.name: get_economic_symbols
tools.title: List economic symbols
tools.description: Catalog of economic tickers accepted by get_economic_data (ECONOMICS:). Without arguments returns a compact overview: indicator categories with counts plus every country code. Pass category (e.g. prce, lbr, gdp) or search (substring) for indicator codes and names; add country (e.g. US) to get ready-to-use tickers.

country.description: Two-letter country/region code, e.g. US, DE, EU, CN. When set, returns ready-to-use ECONOMICS:* tickers instead of bare indicator codes

category.description: Return indicators of one category: gdp, lbr, prce, hlth, mny, trd, gov, bsnss, cnsm, hse, txs, enrg, clmt

search.description: Return indicators whose code or name contains this substring (case-insensitive), e.g. inflation

tools.name: get_news_story
tools.title: Get news story
tools.description: Full text of a news story by its id from get_news: ast_description (AST as string), short_description, summary, permission, provider, copyright.

id.description: Story id in urn format from get_news, e.g. urn:newsml:mtnewswires.com:20260810:A123:0

annotations.title: Full news story text by id

tools.name: get_screener_columns
tools.title: List screener columns
tools.description: Catalog of all TradingView screener column names accepted by get_symbol_data, get_symbol_data_batch and run_screener. Without group/search returns a compact overview: groups with column names only. Pass group (e.g. valuation, technicals) or search (substring) to get descriptions and period/timeframe variants; market narrows to stock, etf, crypto or bond.

market.description: Filter by screener market: stock, etf, crypto, bond or all. Default all

group.description: Return full details (descriptions and period/timeframe variants) for one group, e.g. valuation, technicals, income_statement

search.description: Return full details for columns whose name or description contains this substring (case-insensitive), e.g. margin

tools.name: get_ohlcv
tools.title: Get OHLCV bars
tools.description: Fetch historical OHLCV bars for a symbol at an interval, up to the full available history: at most 5000 bars per call as rows or 8000 as columns (count is capped, see count_limit), optional date_from/date_to window, and paging back in time via date_to=next_date_to when has_more=true. Daily/weekly history goes back to the listing; intraday depth is limited by the data feed to a few thousand bars. Returns aggregate summary and (unless summary=true) the bars as rows [{t (unix sec UTC), o, h, l, c, v}] or, with format="columns", as compact arrays.

symbol.description: Symbol in EXCHANGE:TICKER format, e.g. NASDAQ:NVDA or BINANCE:BTCUSDT

interval.description: Bar interval: 1m 5m 15m 30m 1h 4h 1D 1W (use M / 1mo / month for monthly). Default 1D

count.description: Max bars in this response, default 300; capped to 5000 for format=rows and 8000 for format=columns (response size limit, see count_limit); the most recent bars of the window are returned, older ones are reachable via date_to paging (see has_more / next_date_to)

date_from.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD (or RFC3339), inclusive start of the window; other formats are rejected

date_to.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD (or RFC3339), inclusive end of the window; use next_date_to from the previous response to page back in history

format.description: Bars layout: rows (default, array of {t,o,h,l,c,v}) or columns (arrays t[], o[], h[], l[], c[], v[] — about 40% smaller for large windows)

summary.description: If true, omit the raw bars array and return aggregate statistics only

annotations.title: Historical OHLCV candles by symbol and timeframe

tools.name: get_technicals_rating
tools.title: Get technical rating
tools.description: Full single-timeframe indicator snapshot: RSI, Stoch K/D, CCI20, ADX, MACD, Momentum, AO, EMA/SMA 10-200, VWMA, HullMA9 plus 3 Recommend aggregates (summary/MA/other).

tools.name: run_screener
tools.title: Run screener
tools.description: Run the TradingView screener with filters ({field: [min, max]} plus index/sector/industry/analyst_rating), sorting, presets and column selection. Returns rows and totalCount. Use get_screener_columns to discover valid column names for columns and filters.

market.description: Screener market: america, crypto, forex, futures, bonds, cfd, uk, germany, india, japan, ... Default america

filters.description: Filters as {field: [min, max]} (null side = unbounded) plus special keys index / sector / industry / analyst_rating, e.g. {"index": "S&P 500", "pe": [null, 15], "rsi": [null, 40], "div_yield": [2, null]}

sort_by.description: Column to sort by, default volume

limit.description: Max rows to return, default 100, cap 1000

filter_preset.description: Named preset: pullback_with_reversal, breakout_with_volume, oversold_healthy, earnings_runup, relative_strength, new_highs

annotations.title: Screener results for an abstract text query

tools.name: get_document_view
tools.title: Get document text
tools.description: Text of a specific document view (summary/transcript) by views[].id from get_documents. Never construct view ids manually.

view_id.description: Document view id from get_documents views[].id, verbatim — never construct or edit it

tools.name: get_economic_calendar
tools.title: Get economic calendar
tools.description: Macro events (CPI, GDP, rates) filtered by countries, currencies, category and importance. Past windows work (data since 2003-09-01), forward ~31 days.

countries.description: Comma-separated 2-letter country codes plus regions like EU. Default US

currencies.description: Comma-separated ISO currency codes to filter by: USD,JPY,EUR

category.description: Event category: gdp, bonds, business, consumer, goverment, health, housing, labor, money, prices, trade, taxes. Default all

date_from.description: UTC date/time: YYYY-MM-DD or RFC3339 (other formats are rejected). Default today 00:00. Past works (data since 2003-09-01)

date_to.description: UTC date/time: YYYY-MM-DD or RFC3339 (other formats are rejected), default today 23:59. Forward window ~31 days

annotations.title: Macro events (CPI, GDP, rates) by importance and country

tools.name: get_symbol_data_batch
tools.title: Get symbol data (batch)
tools.description: Quotes/columns for up to 50 symbols (EXCHANGE:TICKER) in one call; unresolved symbols are reported in `missing` with a reason instead of fabricated zeros. Screener backend errors (429/5xx) are returned as success=false, or as partial=true + warnings when only some markets failed — such symbols are unavailable, not unknown. Use get_screener_columns to discover valid column names.

symbols.description: Symbols in EXCHANGE:TICKER format, up to 50, deduplicated

columns.description: TradingView screener columns to fetch. Default: name description close change change_abs volume market_cap_basic price_earnings_ttm sector industry

annotations.title: Quotes for up to 50 symbols in one call

tools.name: get_dividends_calendar
tools.title: Get dividends calendar
tools.description: Dividend data: ex-dates, amount, yield, payment date. Per-symbol mode via symbols[] or market screening mode via date window.

symbols.description: Per-symbol mode: symbols in EXCHANGE:TICKER format

market.description: Market screening mode (uses date_from/date_to), e.g. america

date_from.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD (or RFC3339), screening-mode ex-date window start (default now); other formats are rejected

date_to.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD (or RFC3339), screening-mode ex-date window end (default +30d); other formats are rejected

limit.description: Max rows in screening mode, default 50, cap 200

annotations.title: Dividend data: ex-dates, amount, yield, payment date

tools.name: get_economic_data
tools.title: Get economic series
tools.description: Time series for an economic indicator (e.g. ECONOMICS:USIRYY): [{date, value}] where value is the actual release value, plus unit/scale when available. Tickers are ECONOMICS:; use get_economic_symbols to discover the available countries and indicator codes instead of guessing.

symbol.description: Economic ticker ECONOMICS:<COUNTRY><INDICATOR>, e.g. ECONOMICS:USIRYY. Use get_economic_symbols to discover valid tickers

date_from.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD (or RFC3339), start of the series window (inclusive); other formats are rejected

date_to.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD (or RFC3339), end of the series window (inclusive); other formats are rejected

tools.name: search_symbols
tools.title: Search symbols
tools.description: Resolve a ticker or company name into routable EXCHANGE:TICKER symbols via fuzzy search. Returns symbol, description, type, exchange, logoid.

query.description: Ticker, company name or description to fuzzy-search

type_filter.description: Filter by instrument type: stock, etf, bond, forex, index, futures, crypto. Default all

annotations.title: Resolve ticker or name into EXCHANGE:TICKER (fuzzy search)
